heading: Modernize travel experience with a mobile app

paragraphs.html: We travel for the experience — to experience the thrill of visiting a new place, culture and food. Until the last decade, travel magazines and tour operators helped with going to places. But, it was a cumbersome process. Enjoying a good trip was like winning a jackpot. Travel mobile apps have rewritten the laws of the game. They make travel planning, booking and even navigating during the travel a hassle-free affair.
